summary: M.S. Computer Engineering, RIT (May 2026). Built real-time computer vision and perception systems: TensorRT YOLO visual servoing with ToF-based sensor fusion on Jetson, and camera-pipeline surface inspection using ISP-style wavelet denoising and monocular depth estimation. Experienced in simulation and evaluation pipelines for CV/ML models and ROS2-based robotics.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline with custom image stitching, ISP-style wavelet denoising (sym6+bior3.5), and ZoeDepth monocular depth for 3D crack-depth profiling at ±8% error.
Achieved PSNR of 86 (vs. homography baseline of 65) via alpha-blended wavelet bank suppressing low-frequency noise.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Built a multi-modal medical imaging data pipeline for BraTS 2020 3D volumetric inputs; trained and evaluated U-Net with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones on Dice Score and IoU.
Led team of 7 as sole ML-experienced member; restructured task distribution to deliver full CV pipeline within 6-week window.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT visual document understanding transformer; built PyTorch VisionEncoderDecoder pipeline improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led 25-member robotics team across national competitions; owned AI/ML integration, PCB fabrication, and sensor communication over UART and I2C.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS with dual VL53L0X ToF sensor fusion for contact-aware grasping; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Built three-layer distributed perception pipeline (Jetson+Arduino+Flask-SocketIO); resolved 11 integration failures across sensor crosstalk, rolling-shutter depth, and false-positive detections.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving Simulation & Evaluation — CARLA
bullets: Built automated simulation data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation; produced ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated zero collisions and traffic light compliance across Town02 evaluation runs.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret — Jetson + STM32
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 real-time perception on Jetson; fused camera detections with VL53L0X ToF for range-gated tracking with FreeRTOS task coordination and interrupt-driven UART bridge to STM32.

projects.name: ROS2-Based Robotic Arm — UR5e & AL5B
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; planned collision-free pick-and-place via UR ROS 2 driver — AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.
